//: The deno config every browser bundle in this repository is built with. It maps the runtime FFI subpath to the wasm adapter's stem-only resolver, keeping the native archive cascade out of the graph. The remaining node:net and bun:ffi stubs cover runtime adapters a bundler may discover through the dynamic adapter import, though the injected web adapter never selects them. React is pinned to the version the Rooms page type-checks against. Use with `deno bundle --platform browser --config bindings/ts/web/browser-bundle.json <entry>`.
